description.value: Indian Burger Joint is a fast-casual 100% vegetarian Indian fusion restaurant founded in 2023 by Navneet Bhadu, serving burgers, grilled naan-wiches, hotdogs, tacos, and Indian street food seasoned with traditional regional spices. The Kingsway location is one of six across BC and runs late into the night, making it a practical refueling stop for cyclists on this busy corridor. The entirely meat-free menu with vegan options throughout is a distinctive offering rarely found at a quick-service restaurant.
